Rafael —

I ran the numbers. At a 25% concession for the first 90 days (they estimate 3.2M tokens in month 1) our incremental gross margin impact is ~22k for Q2, with upside if they convert to a committed annual contract. This looks like a textbook retention-onboarding concession — high lead indicator for enterprise motion.

Recommend: request exec approval for 25% for 90 days with these controls:
- Max billable tokens month 1 capped at 4M (overage billed at list)
- Auto-reversion to list after day 91
- 6-month committed pilot addendum (they sign a short MSA amendment)
- One-time $10k onboarding credit (offset early ops cost)

If we get signoff, I can deliver an updated term sheet and DocuSign packet.

—Ben

Team — escalating to leadership for a fast decision. Summary and ask below.

Summary:
- Account: ClearBridge Health (prospect -> pilot). Potential ARR: ~$1.2M if pilot converts.
- Ask: 25% off Hosted API unit rate for first 90 days; $10k onboarding credit.
- Rationale: Large healthcare brand, strategic in-region partner, likely to expand to Dedicated and private deployments; competitor X has offered a 20% two-month trial to lock them in.
- Risks: Short-term revenue impact, precedent for other deals. Mitigations: hard caps, short term, legal-approved addendum, non-renewal clause unless signed committed contract.

Recommended approval request to execs:
- Approve up to 25% concession for 90 days for ClearBridge Health contingent on the controls above.
- Delegation: revenue impact <= $50k can be approved by Head of Sales; ask for senior exec sign-off if higher.

Please advise urgently — ClearBridge asked for our response by Monday EOD.

—Mina

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Subject: RE: Exec escalation: recommendation for competitive retention concession (ClearBridge)

Thank you for the clear summary. I reviewed the margins and strategic case with Finance and Legal. Executive decision: APPROVED at 25% for 90 days with the following mandatory terms to include in the addendum and DocuSign packet:

1) Term: 90-day promotional period starting on pilot activation date.
2) Usage cap: billable tokens capped at 4,000,000 for month 1; overages billed at list price.
3) Auto-reversion: rates revert to list automatically on day 91; no auto-renew of the promotional rate.
4) Commitment window: ClearBridge must sign a 6-month pilot addendum within 7 business days of activation or the promotional pricing is void.
5) One-time onboarding credit: $10,000 applied to first invoice.
6) Audit & reporting: ClearBridge agrees to weekly usage reports and a joint go/no-go review at day 60.
7) Legal: finalize addendum with standard non-precedent clause and approvals from Sales Ops.

Ben/Rafael — you have the green light. Please send the updated term sheet and DocuSign link to Sarah + procurement and copy Legal (legal@redwood.ai). Keep me posted on signatures.

—Marissa
SVP, Global Sales, Redwood Inference
